title: Puharich first announces his Geller work at Zellerbach Auditorium

tellings.quote: and at Berkeley I sponsored a conference at in Zelerbach auditorium. 1,800 people showed up uh and Puharic was one of the speakers and it was at that conference that he made the very first public announcement about his work with Uri Geller

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, who has a PhD and studies psychic phenomena, says that in 1972 he sponsored a conference at Zellerbach Auditorium in Berkeley that drew 1,800 people. One of the speakers was a researcher named Andrija Puharich, and Mishlove says it was there that Puharich made his very first public announcement about his work with a man named Uri Geller, who was said to have psychic powers. Mishlove tells Michels this as someone who organised the event and was in the room.
